items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Ever hear of Jim Thorpe, he started just like you.

ctx.x: And Ida loved it and we got movies -- I have it downstairs and the way I rigged up this tour, I wanted to talk to the kids, Indian kids, so I'd play a set and then we had an intermission and at intermission time I'd take the mike into the center of the stage and get me a chair and I'd sit down and my first word would be, 'Hello.' And everybody says, 'Hello.' 'I'd love to talk to you.' Then I'd go on to my spiel about staying in school and keep up their education and talked about other people that came from humble…
